```python
def get_X_step_bias(self, own=None):
    """Worker bias B = own normalized load + (z - X - u)/W."""
    if own is None: own = np.zeros_like(self._Z)
    W = self._workers
    return own + (self._Z - self._X - self._dual_var)/W

def get_Z_step_bias(self):
    """Controller target V = alpha*X + (1-alpha)*Z + u."""
    self._V = self._alpha*self._X + (1-self._alpha)*self._Z + self._dual_var
    return self._V
```

```python
class Coordinator:
    def __init__(self, n, rho, alpha):
        self._n = n
        self._alpha = alpha
        self.rho = rho
        self._outer_admm_wrapper = ADMMWrapper(n, rho, alpha=alpha)
        self._outer_admm_wrapper.initialize(np.zeros(n))
        self._mlu_solver = PDLPMLU(n, rho, 'route')
        self._live = np.ones(n, dtype=bool)

    @property
    def Z(self): return self._outer_admm_wrapper.Z
    @property
    def dual(self): return self._outer_admm_wrapper.dual_var

    def retune(self, rho):
        self.rho = rho
        self._outer_admm_wrapper.retile(rho)
        self._mlu_solver.rho = rho

    def bias(self, own):
        """Normalized signed bias for one worker."""
        B = self._outer_admm_wrapper.get_X_step_bias(own)
        return np.where(self._live, B, 0.0)

    def step(self, x, active, mode):
        self._live = np.asarray(active, dtype=bool)
        self._outer_admm_wrapper.record_X_update(np.asarray(x, dtype=float))
        V = self._outer_admm_wrapper.get_Z_step_bias()
        V = np.where(self._live, V, 0.0)
        self._mlu_solver._objective = mode
        self._mlu_solver.active = self._live
        self._mlu_solver.update_F_m(V, rho=self.rho)
        z, h, t = self._mlu_solver.solve()
        u = np.where(self._live, V - z, 0.0)
        self._outer_admm_wrapper.record_Z_update(z)
        self._outer_admm_wrapper.record_dual_update(u)
        return {'z': z, 'ceiling': h, 'pressure': t, 'dual': u, 'target': V}
```
